{{Quote|What's the third ingredient?''"<br />"''A star-shaped quill from one of the dandelion warriors.|Wicket Warrick and the shaman [[Logray/Legends|Logray]]|<ref name="Wicket and the Dandelion Warriors: An Ewok Adventure">''[[Wicket and the Dandelion Warriors: An Ewok Adventure]]''</ref>}}
'''"Star urchin quills"''' was the name given by [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Shaman/Legends|shamans]] to the venomous quills of the [[fftssfft]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sapient]] [[Plant/Legends|plants]] also known as the "dandelion warriors." Despite their potentially [[Death/Legends|lethal]] nature, those star-shaped quills could be used in traditional Ewok medicine.
